from.place: the derived pullback composition proof needs pullback to preserve K-flat resolutions

title: Pullback preserves K-flat complexes
statement: Let $f:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed spaces, consisting of a continuous map $f:X\to Y$ and a morphism of sheaves of rings $f^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$, with adjoint map $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$. For a complex $K^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules, let $f^*K^\bullet$ be the termwise pullback $f^{-1}K^\bullet\otimes_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}\mathcal O_X$ using inverse image [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] with its canonical module structure [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module] and sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. If $K^\bullet$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], then $f^*K^\bullet$ is K-flat over $\mathcal O_X$.

proof.text: The shape and square-zero laws of the explicit tensorPullbackDifferential follow from preservation of zero and composition by the inverse-image abelian-sheaf functor, sectionwise ModuleCat.extendScalars, and module sheafification. The four private helpers prove these laws directly from functor laws; apply K.shape and K.d_comp_d.
Package (X,OX) and (Y,OY) as ringed spaces. The forward implication of the K-flat stalk criterion applied to K on Y gives K-flatness of K_(f x) for each x.

Apply the termwise tensor-pullback stalk-complex comparison to the constructed pullback P, with identity termwise isomorphisms. Its differential compatibility square is the equality d≫id=id≫d. Obtain a ring map ρ:OY_(f x)→OX_x and a chain isomorphism from extension of scalars of K_(f x) to P_x.

For any acyclic OX_x-complex L, K-flat module base change gives acyclicity of Tot(L⊗ extension_ρ K_(f x)). Map the preceding chain isomorphism through the functor Tot(L⊗-), and apply HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_iso in every degree to transfer acyclicity to Tot(L⊗P_x).
The reverse implication of the K-flat stalk criterion on X now proves IsKFlat of the tensor pullback complex.
